Alternative LMC-relative solution with the F99 extinction curve and gamma=-0.23 mag dex^-1 fixed from the literature. The quoted uncertainty is random and no absolute LMC zero point is included.
Relative modulus to the LMC with no absolute LMC zero point added. The F99 extinction curve uses RI=1.2899 and yields gamma=-0.406+/-0.144 mag dex^-1.
Alternative FM07 result with gamma=-0.23 mag dex^-1 fixed. It is relative to the LMC without adding its absolute modulus. FM07 provides the smallest sensitivity to the adopted reddening cut.
Preferred relative modulus; no LMC zero point is added. FM07 uses RI=1.1450, gives gamma=-0.384+/-0.144 mag dex^-1, and is least sensitive to the reddening cut. Only random error is quoted.
